rule: At least two of three methods must satisfy every per-method requirement. Otherwise the stronger downstream-learning claim is unsupported.
claim_boundary: A pass supports only that VALID-OT-selected top-two margin improves this controlled HER2ST cross-domain label-transfer task relative to maximum coupling probability. It does not establish general real-section or full-pipeline improvement.
calibration_disclosure: The preceding label-transfer calibration was NO-GO because median macro-F1 improvement was 0.0408 versus a frozen 0.05 threshold; this score comparison is exploratory.
